invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Option, which is non-null by construction.
If isMetadataTable() is true, the method returns Option.empty(), so result.isPresent() must be false.
If neither method config.isMetadataTableEnabled nor metaClient.getTableConfig().isMetadataTableAvailable is true, result will be Option.empty().
result is Option.of(metadataWriter) only under all these conditions; otherwise Option.empty().
If result is not present, then at least one of these enabling conditions must be false.
